arxiv-2205-13828.creator: Ji-Gang Ren, Maimaiti Abulizi, Hai-Lin Yong, Juan Yin, Xue-Jiao Li, Yuan Jiang, Wei-Yang Wang, Hua-Jian Xue, Yu-He Chen, Biao Jin, Ya-Yun Yin, Zhou-Yu Tu, Xiao-Juan Zhu, Shuang-Qiang Zhao, Feng-Zhi Li, Sheng-Kai Liao, Wen-Qi Cai, Wei-Yue Liu, Yuan Cao, Fei Zhou, Li Li, Nai-Le Liu, Qiang Zhang, Yu-Ao
arxiv-2205-13828.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ji-Gang Ren, Maimaiti Abulizi, Hai-Lin Yong, Juan Yin, Xue-Jiao Li, Yuan Jiang, Wei-Yang Wang, Hua-Jian Xue, Yu-He Chen, Biao Jin, Ya-Yun Yin, Zhou-Yu Tu, Xiao-Juan Zhu, Shuang-Qiang Zhao, Feng-Zhi Li, Sheng-Kai Liao, Wen-Qi Cai, Wei-Yue Liu, Yuan Cao, Fei Zhou, Li Li, Nai-Le Liu, Qiang Zhang, Yu-Ao. Quantum key distribution (QKD) uses the fundamental principles of quantum mechanics to share unconditionally secure keys between distant users.

arxiv-2206-14703.title: A friendly iteration forcing that the four cardinal characteristics of ℰ \mathcal{E} can be pairwise different
arxiv-2206-14703.creator: Miguel A. Cardona
arxiv-2206-14703.description: Abstract . Let ℰ \mathcal{E} be the σ \sigma -ideal generated by the closed measure zero sets of reals. We use an ultrafilter-extendable matrix iteration of ccc posets to force that, for ℰ \mathcal{E} , their associated cardinal characteristics (i.e. additivity, covering, uniformity and cofinality) are pairwise different. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 03E05, 03E15, 03E17, 03E35, 03E40 1.

arxiv-2305-07284.title: A Full Quantum Generative Adversarial Network Model for High Energy Physics Simulations
arxiv-2305-07284.creator: Florian Rehm 1,2, Sofia Vallecorsa 1, Michele Grossi 1, Kerstin Borras 2,3, Dirk Krücker 3
arxiv-2305-07284.description: Abstract The prospect of quantum computing with a potential exponential speed-up compared to classical computing identifies it as a promising method in the search for alternative future High Energy Physics (HEP) simulation approaches. HEP simulations, such as employed at the Large Hadron Collider at CERN, are extraordinarily complex and require an immense amount of computing resources in hardware and time.

arxiv-2307-08210.title: Delay Alignment Modulation with Hybrid Beamforming for Spatially Sparse Communications Thanks: This work was supported by the National Key R&D Program of China with Grant number 2019YFB1803400.
arxiv-2307-08210.creator: Jieni Zhang ∗ and Yong Zeng ∗†
arxiv-2307-08210.description: Abstract For millimeter wave (mmWave) or Terahertz (THz) communications, by leveraging the high spatial resolution offered by large antenna arrays and the multi-path sparsity of mmWave/THz channels, a novel inter-symbol interference (ISI) mitigation technique called delay alignment modulation (DAM) has been recently proposed. The key ideas of DAM are delay pre-compensation and path-based beamforming .

arxiv-2310-17575.title: Synthetic Detections of Interstellar Objects with The Rubin Observatory Legacy Survey of Space and Time
arxiv-2310-17575.creator: Dušan Marčeta, Darryl Z. Seligman
arxiv-2310-17575.description: Abstract The discovery of two interstellar objects passing through the Solar System, 1I/‘Oumuamua and 2I/Borisov, implies that a galactic population exists with a spatial number density of order ∼ 0.1 \sim 0.1 au -3 . The forthcoming Rubin Observatory Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST) has been predicted to detect more asteroidal interstellar objects like 1I/‘Oumuamua.

arxiv-2402-19221.title: FKS subtraction for quarkonium production at NLO
arxiv-2402-19221.creator: Ajjath A H, Hua-Sheng Shao, and Lukas Simon
arxiv-2402-19221.description: Abstract We extend the local infrared-divergence subtraction formalism, originally proposed by Frixione, Kunszt and Signer (FKS), to calculate short-distance (differential) cross section for any inclusive process involving a quarkonium particle in non-relativistic QCD (NRQCD) factorisation at next-to-leading order (NLO) accuracy in the strong coupling constant α s \alpha_{s} .

arxiv-2410-04198.title: DJ Mix Transcription with Multi-Pass Non-Negative Matrix Factorization
arxiv-2410-04198.creator: Étienne Paul André, Dominique Fourer, Diemo Schwarz
arxiv-2410-04198.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Étienne Paul André, Dominique Fourer, Diemo Schwarz. DJ mix transcription is a crucial step towards DJ mix reverse engineering, which estimates the set of parameters and audio effects applied to a set of existing tracks to produce a performative DJ mix. We introduce a new approach based on a multi-pass NMF algorithm where the dictionary matrix corresponds to a set of spectrogram slices of the source tracks present in the mix.

arxiv-2602-03383.title: Dynamic Topology Optimization for Non-IID Data in Decentralized Learning
arxiv-2602-03383.creator: Bart Cox, Antreas Ioannou, Jérémie Decouchant
arxiv-2602-03383.description: Abstract Decentralized learning (DL) enables a set of nodes to train a model collaboratively without central coordination, offering benefits for privacy and scalability. However, DL struggles to train a high accuracy model when the data distribution is non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) and when the communication topology is static.

pmc-10505926.title: A Large-format Polyacrylamide Gel with Controllable Matrix Mechanics for Mammalian Cell Culture and Conditioned Media Production
pmc-10505926.creator: Catherine S Millar-Haskell, Jason P Gleghorn
pmc-10505926.description: Tissue culture plastic has been used for routine cell culture and in vitro experiments for over 50 years. However, cells are mechanically responsive and behave differently on hard surfaces than they do on softer substrates. Polyacrylamide gels have become a popular hydrogel of choice for controlling surface stiffness and ligand density for cell adhesion.

pmc-10577093.title: Usefulness of a Low-Dose Sclerosing Agent for the Treatment of Vascular Lesions in the Tongue
pmc-10577093.creator: Taeil Lim, Doogyum Kim, Hyun-Woo Lee, Joo-Young Ohe, Junho Jung
pmc-10577093.description: Hemangiomas and vascular malformations are common benign lesions of vessels in the cervical region. However, the lesions may not completely disappear and may require surgical or nonsurgical intervention. Several treatment options, including surgical excision, steroid injection, laser therapy, and sclerotherapy, are available.

pmc-10630879.title: Expression of concern: Synthesis and characterization of a new ZIF-67@MgAl2O4 nanocomposite and its adsorption behaviour
pmc-10630879.creator: Mehdi Davoodi, Fatemeh Davar, Mohammad R. Rezayat, Mohammad T. Jafari, Mehdi Bazarganipour, Ahmed Esmail Shalan

pmc-10797237.title: Benign fasciculation syndrome and migraine aura without headache as possible adverse events after BNT162b2 mRNA vaccination: a web-based survey
pmc-10797237.creator: Grgur Salai, Đivo Ljubičić, Ruđer Novak, Lovorka Grgurević
pmc-10797237.description: AimTo determine the characteristics of patients who experienced muscle fasciculations and migraine auras without headache after BNT162b2 immunization.MethodsIn January 2022, we published a case report that described a 48-year-old female patient who experienced muscle twitching and migraine auras without headache following BNT162b2 immunization.

pmc-11318505.title: MAPPING THE COSTS AND SOCIOECONOMIC CHARACTERISTICS INVOLVED IN TRAUMATIC BRAIN INJURIES: A SCOPING REVIEW
pmc-11318505.creator: Fanny CROZES, Cyrille DELPIERRE, Nadège COSTA
pmc-11318505.description: ObjectiveTo identify the articles in the existing literature that analyse healthcare costs according to the socioeconomic position (pre- or post-injury) for traumatic brain injury survivors. Secondary aims were to describe the types of costs and socioeconomic characteristics and to determine whether socioeconomic characteristics affect the risk of traumatic brain injury or whether the consequences of trauma alter living conditions post-injury.

pmc-11434339.title: Polymorph Screening of Core-Chlorinated Naphthalene Diimides with Different Fluoroalkyl Side-Chain Lengths
pmc-11434339.creator: Inês de Oliveira Martins, Marianna Marchini, Lucia Maini, Enrico Modena, Xin Huang, Ting Wang
pmc-11434339.description: In this work, naphthalenediimide (NDI) derivatives are widely studied for their semiconducting properties and the influence of the side-chain length on the crystal packing is reported, along with the thermal properties of three core-chlorinated NDIs with different fluoroalkyl side-chain lengths (CF3-NDI, C3F7-NDI and C4F9-NDI).

pmc-11859990.title: Fundamental beliefs, as well as levels of depression, anxiety, and stress experienced by Russian students during the second wave of the COVID-19 pandemic
pmc-11859990.creator: V. I. Rozhdestvenskiy, V. V. Titova, I. A. Gorkovaya, D. O. Ivanov, Y. S. Aleksandrovich
pmc-11859990.description: IntroductionA pandemic caused by a novel coronavirus is an immensely traumatic event. Researches indicate that such events significantly impact various aspects of individuals, including their physical, emotional, cognitive, behavioural, and social functions, affecting different components of their personality structure. However, the experience of trauma itself is influenced by implicit internal structures known as underlying beliefs.

pmc-12567151.title: 2EZBFT for Decentralized Oracle Consensus with Distant Smart Terminals
pmc-12567151.creator: Yuke Cao, Kun She
pmc-12567151.description: In geo-distributed deployments, sensor data are collected under the coordination of smart terminals and relayed on-chain via decentralized oracles. A motivating scenario involves healthcare networks where regional hospitals submit aggregated medical data to blockchain systems while maintaining strict information security—often designating one gateway per region for external communication.

pmc-12594957.title: Multimodal-based auxiliary diagnosis for pediatric community acquired pneumonia
pmc-12594957.creator: Yiwen Wang, Yanying Rao, Yuhang Zhu, Jiacong Wu, Bingtian Qiao, Xiaoyan Wu, Qiuyu Tang, Zhezhuang Xu
pmc-12594957.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Community-acquired pneumonia (CAP) remains one of the leading causes of death among pediatric patients under the age of 5, making timely and accurate diagnosis crucial for subsequent treatment. While numerous artificial intelligence diagnostic methods for pneumonia have shown reliable results, most of them still exhibit significant limitations: (a) They only rely on single-modality data, which have limitations in capturing comprehensive clinical information; (b) They do not consider differences in postures among pediatric patients, resulting in constrained diagnostic performance and generalizability.

pmc-12619014.title: Developing a Community of Practice to Provide Care Coordination and Address Health-Related Social Needs for Veterans Receiving Care in Community-Based Settings: Program Development and Survey Study
pmc-12619014.creator: Carolyn Turvey, Natalie Suiter, Rhonda Fellows, Shawna Domeyer, Lindsey Fuhrmeister, Amanda Heeren, Kimberly McCoy, M Bryant Howren, Javad Sarvestan, Derrecka Boykin, Michael Rigby
pmc-12619014.description: BackgroundApproximately half of US veterans receive care outside of US Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration facilities—a proportion expected to rise due to the Promise to Address Comprehensive Toxics Act and expanded use of VA-purchased community care.ObjectiveThis paper describes the structure and impact of the Veterans Care Coordination in Community Settings (VetCoor) program.

pmc-13059358.title: GWAS on yield-related traits of Pakistani wheat under post-anthesis heat stress
pmc-13059358.creator: Shabbir Hussain, Fanmei Kong, Ishrat Naureen, Madiha Habib, Nida Ghori, Faisal Saeed Awan, Hasham Feroz Ghuman, Kiran Hameed, Xiaocun Zhang
pmc-13059358.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Heat stress is a major threat to spring wheat (Triticum aestivum) production in the Indo-Gangetic plains of South Asia, particularly in India and Pakistan. Breeding for heat-tolerant cultivars is an effective strategy to improve wheat productivity in stressed environments. To identify quantitative trait loci (QTL) for heat tolerance, we conducted a genome-wide association study (GWAS) to identify marker-trait associations (MTAs) using single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) markers generated via genotyping-by-sequencing (GBS).

pmc-13158365.title: Establishment of Breast Cancer Organoids: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
pmc-13158365.creator: Vinícius Marques Rocha, Maria Lucia Hirata Katayama, Larissa Oliveira Amorim, Beatriz Domenici de Oliveira, Rossana Veronica Mendoza Lopez, Maria Aparecida Azevedo Koike Folgueira, Dimiter Avtanski
pmc-13158365.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundOrganoid culture has emerged as a promising model for studying normal and tumor tissues. Organoids may resemble their tissue of origin, allowing assessment of disease behavior and drug response. In breast cancer (BC), successful organoid establishment may depend on factors like time from tissue collection to culture, dissociation methods, and media composition, which may affect tumor growth and tissue similarity across culture passages.

pmc-13456892.title: Giant retroperitoneal leiomyosarcoma of massive proportions: a case report
pmc-13456892.creator: Rodolfo Chávez-Magallón, Liliana Daniela Suárez-Velázquez, Karen Fabiola Miramontes-Rodríguez, Fernanda Dessired Parra-Gómez, Iris Jocelyn Parrao-Alcántara, Kenny Omar Contreras-Becerra
pmc-13456892.description: Introduction:Retroperitoneal leiomyosarcoma is a rare malignant neoplasm with insidious growth and delayed clinical presentation. Giant tumors pose major surgical challenges because of their anatomical relationships and the frequent need for multivisceral resection to achieve oncological control.Case presentation:We report the case of a 47-year-old male who presented with progressive abdominal distension and nonspecific symptoms.
